title: Totem Bing
description: This mod notifies you if you have an available totem if you don't have one in your off hand.
body:
This mod adds a notification so if you dont have a totem in your off hand(bad) and you have one in your inventory that you should put in your off hand. 

This is useful for gamemodes like crystal pvp, tnt minecart pvp and gamemodes where keeping track of totems is important.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
